status: design-only: invented content; no executable connector

items.summary: Example panel is ready for review

journeys.given: Same connection and source_key replayed twice
journeys.expect: One item; revision may update, count does not double

journeys.given: Dismiss email locally then replay a changed provider revision
journeys.expect: Still locally dismissed; provider unread unchanged; Undo available
Local seen only; no remote mark-read request; provider application may change read state after explicit Open

journeys.given: New message in a dismissed thread
journeys.expect: New source_key remains new; grouping does not discard it
Permission lost, not an empty successful inbox; no silent re-consent

journeys.given: Disabled connector receives an import request
journeys.expect: Refuse without account call; world props cannot grant consent

journeys.given: Same words via email and phone without verified shared identity
journeys.expect: Never fuzzy-merge; suppress mirrored app only by explicit source policy

journeys.given: Game guard unknown, gaming or machine asleep
journeys.expect: No sync, wake timer, app launch or prompt
One bounded catch-up after guard allows; no toast storm or resident wake

journeys.given: Disconnect while an import is queued
journeys.expect: Generation invalidated; queued import refused; private cache removed locally, remote revocation reported separately
